subject: Invoice routing & VAT treatment causing payment hold
messages:
From: Lara Chen <billing@greenfield.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@greenfield.ai
Date: Thu, 28 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: Payment hold: invoice shows VAT applied to EU entity

Hi Vanessa,

Our payments team placed the July invoice (attached) on hold. The invoice currently lists VAT reverse-charge applied to Greenfield Labs — EU entity — but our AP needs the VAT routed to the US parent for this payment run. Because of the mismatch, our bank declined the transfer and we need a corrected invoice to release payment.

Can Redwood issue an updated invoice or confirm which entity should be billed so we can proceed? We were also asked why the original invoice shows a token-level VAT line (looks like the metering export attached) — any context there would help.

Attachments: Greenfield_Invoice_20280726.pdf, RV-alloc-map.csv

Thanks,
Lara Chen
Billing Lead
Greenfield Labs

billing@greenfield.ai
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Lara Chen <billing@greenfield.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 28 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Payment hold: invoice shows VAT applied to EU entity

Hi Lara — thank you for flagging this and sharing the files.

Quick summary for transparency: we believe the charge was attributed to Greenfield's EU seat because their API keys are scoped to the EU tenant. That caused our billing export to mark the line as reverse-charge VAT for EU compliance. If you want the charge on the US parent instead we can reissue an invoice, but we need confirmation of the correct billing entity and PO number.

Ben / Connor / Kim — looping you in to propose a path to unfreeze payment. Could finance reissue a corrected invoice (billing to US entity) and confirm whether we should apply a netting credit for the misclassification? Lara — if you can confirm the US legal entity name and PO (or let us know if AP prefers a self-bill waiver), we can expedite.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Lara Chen <billing@greenfield.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 28 Jul 2028 13:25:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Payment hold: invoice shows VAT applied to EU entity

Thanks Vanessa — Lara, sorry for the extra friction. Proposed steps from sales ops to resolve this within 48 hours:

1) We reissue an corrected invoice billed to the US parent (please confirm legal name + PO).
2) Finance will mark the original invoice as superseded (no further collection action) and attach a short note about VAT policy to prevent downstream routing errors.
3) Connor will provide the metering snapshot and token attribution that caused the VAT flag so your AP has an audit trail.

Connor — can you grab the token attribution export for the July 20-26 window and drop it in this thread (or to Kim directly)? Kim — will finance need any additional approvals to reissue?

Ben
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Lara Chen <billing@greenfield.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jul 2028 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Payment hold: invoice shows VAT applied to EU entity

Hi all — added details from finance side:

- We can reissue a corrected invoice billed to the US parent. We will mark the previous invoice as 'void - superseded' and include a short explanation referencing the metering attribution.
- No internal approvals required for a one-off reissue under $50k; this is below threshold.
- Please confirm the US legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the invoice, the billing address, and the PO number. Once confirmed we'll generate the corrected PDF and e-invoice link (typical turnaround: same business day).

Connor — the token attribution CSV (RV-alloc-map.csv) looks like it caused the EU billing tag; can you confirm whether the keys were created under the EU tenant or were a cross-tenant call? If cross-tenant, note that our current routing attempts to assign charges to the tenant owning the API key by default.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Lara Chen <billing@greenfield.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Payment hold: invoice shows VAT applied to EU entity — corrected invoice attached

Lara — thanks for confirming the US entity. Attached is the corrected invoice (redwood-corrected-invoice-20280730.pdf) billed to Greenfield Labs, Inc. (US parent) and the DocuSign e-invoice link.

Summary of actions taken:
- Original invoice (20280726) voided and marked superseded in our billing system.
- New invoice generated billed to Greenfield Labs, Inc. (US) with PO 900182.
- Attachments: corrected invoice PDF and token attribution snapshot for audit.
- Finance will note the VAT reclassification in the transaction memo to prevent automated routing on your side.

Please confirm when AP has cleared the payment so we can close the ticket. If your bank still rejects the transfer, copy in "accounts-payable@greenfield.ai" and we'll open a payments trace.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-corrected-invoice-20280730.pdf
Link: https://app.docusign.com/signed/5482-REDWOOD-INVOICE-CORR
